description:
Makes the `ldpc_bler_sweep` binary of `gf2-sim` decode the frames of each slice through the batch soft-decoder trait.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. The binary `ldpc_bler_sweep` estimates block error rates: each parallel slice owns a seeded LLR source and a single-frame decoder and decodes its frames one at a time.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each slice generates its LLR frames in the unchanged seeded order and decodes them through one batch decoder per slice, held through the trait.
- [hard] REQ-02: For a fixed seed the frame error count of each SNR point equals the single-frame path's, for one worker and for the pool default, in a test over a short code.
- [hard] REQ-03: The binary holds no decoding logic beyond handing frames to the library.
title: Decode BLER sweep slices through the batch decoder trait
